idiom_name: switch over an enum with associated values (exhaustive), forwarding to typed destinations
implementation_notes: Model each message as an enum case carrying its own payload and route with switch: the compiler requires the switch to be exhaustive, so a new message case is a build error until it has a destination, which replaces the classic router object and its condition chain with the type itself. Decode the wire discriminator once - Codable plus an explicit .unknown case or a throwing initializer for unrecognised kinds - before routing, and let each arm forward to its destination: a typed continuation (AsyncStream<Order>.Continuation), an actor method, or a Combine publisher where filter/switchToLatest express the same routing over a stream. Choose the switch form for value-based rules and a publisher/stream operator when the rules are part of a longer reactive pipeline.
pitfalls: Decoding into the enum fails at the decoder, not in the router: define an explicit .unknown case (or throw and route the error) so an unrecognised discriminator is observable instead of crashing.
yield on an AsyncStream continuation applies no back-pressure - the bufferingPolicy chosen at construction decides what happens to the excess, and the default is unbounded.

Yield before the consumer starts is bounded by the same policy (bufferingOldest/bufferingNewest drop or suspend), so a router active during startup can lose messages unless the buffer is sized deliberately.
